_comment: Tracked recurring issues found by the weekly calibration agent. Each issue has: id, theme (or category, or null for global), first_observed (run_id), last_observed (run_id), status (open|monitoring|resolved), description, evidence_runs (list of run_ids), actions_taken (list of {run_date, action}), recommendation_pending (bool, true if the fix requires a human edit to a forbidden/prompt-level field).

issues.description: CRITICAL: Catastrophic theme score collapse affecting weekday themes (Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday) persisting since July 26—now 16 consecutive runs with no recovery. Mean theme scores as of August 9: Monday 8.2 (baseline was ~26-30), Tuesday 3.2 (effectively dead), Wednesday 9.0 (weak partial recovery), Thursday 4.7 (dead). Weekend themes unaffected (Friday 37.7, Saturday 39.5, Sunday 49.1), ruling out global scoring failure. Composite histograms show catastrophic concentration: Tuesday 1556/1566 articles in 0-19 band, Thursday 1553/1565 in 0-19. Podcast feeds critically thin (Monday avg 13 articles vs target 100, Tuesday avg 10), while weekend holdover banks overflow (1381+ Friday, 1426+ Saturday, 1376+ Sunday). This is a scoring_prompt or theme_description regression introduced around July 26, NOT a threshold issue—mean_theme_score of 3.2 cannot be fixed by lowering min_score. The collapse was immediate (not gradual), weekday-specific (not global), and has persisted unchanged for 16 runs, indicating a fundamental scoring logic break in weekday theme definitions.

actions_taken.action: None—this requires human review of scoring_prompt and theme_description fields for Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, which are in the forbidden auto-edit list. No auto-tunable knob (min_score, holdover_threshold, keyword additions) will fix a near-zero mean_theme_score caused by a scoring failure. Flagging as open recurring issue pending human intervention.
